column3: Kill 14 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
column4: Mug'Thol and his Crushridge ogres have overrun the ruins of Alterac. It will be hard to inflict any serious punishment upon him without thinning out the ogres' numbers.$b$bAfter softening them up, we'll proceed.$b$bUnderstood? Good. Now go.

column3: Speak with Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay.
column4: Back to what you came here about. I know I promised Pozzik that I'd deliver a new fuel regulator for him, but I still haven't received it yet. Revilgaz over in Booty Bay said he'd have it shipped over, but it might be it slipped through the cracks somehow.$b$bIf that's true, there's not much we can do about it. We can at least find out if it was dispatched from Booty Bay.$b$bCheck in with Wharfmaster Lozgil over there, he should be able to check the cargo records.

column3: Find and kill Fozruk.  Bring the Rod of Order to the Keystone in the Arathi Highlands.
column4: Opening the Stones of Binding loosened much of my confinement, but a lock still holds me chained.  It is the Keystone you see among this circle of stones.  And the key is held by one of my captors, the stone watcher Fozruk.$B$BYou must obtain that key, which the stone watchers call the Rod of Order, from Fozruk and use it to open the Keystone.$B$B$n, you have done so much to aid me.  Just a little more...and my gratitude will shake the very foundations of the earth!

column3: Bring an Intact Tallstrider Beak to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.
column4:
These markings are from a lion. By the look of them, this one is especially large--the leader of the nearby pride.

I would gladly hunt the beast myself, but you have first claim. Instead, I will aid you.

I can make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider. You can use it to lure the lion out. I'll just need one of their beaks to give it the right sound.

There are tallstriders all over the plains. Find me a beak and the hunt can begin!

column3: Bring proof of Old Rot-Chum's demise to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
column4: Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.\r\n\r\nA reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.

column3: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
column4: Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.$B$BIf you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, $n.$B$BWhen you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, $n, the night elves may wish to impede your test.

column3: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
column4: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war.  No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.$B$BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple.  Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going.  Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $n!

column3: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
column4: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old shaman in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.

column3: Bring a mug of Southshore Stout to Valik in the Syndicate camp.
column4: Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the enemy.$b$bNo doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some Southshore stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.

column3: Retrieve the Sigil of Arathor and return it to Zengu in Hammerfall.
column4: Though they can barely be said to control Stromgarde, let alone the whole of Arathi Highlands, the human prince trots the remnants of his cavalry over the countryside. I can't understand why he does it, but who understands the way the humans think, hm?$b$bWhatever his reasoning, more importantly, he has given one of the sigils to Lieutenant Valorcall, their cavalry leader. Locate him and bring his sigil back to me.
